summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PPh 22 feature (Fase 4) and full regression testing. All PPh 22 features working correctly: default rate management, per-date custom rates (auto %), manual amounts (Rp), reset functionality, validations, Excel export with PPh columns, and UI components. Health endpoint verified. All regression items passed.
passed_tests: Health endpoint GET /api/ returns status ok + database connected (no auth required)
Login admin utama (yumaclovstar@gmail.com) and admin cadangan (admin@ptsjm.co.id)
GET /api/settings/pph returns default rate 0.25% and system_default 0.25%
PUT /api/settings/pph changes default rate (admin only, affects all auto mode dates)
POST /api/finance/pph auto mode with custom rate_pct (e.g., 1.5%) - pph22 calculated correctly, pph_custom=true
POST /api/finance/pph manual mode with amount - pph22 = exact amount, pph_mode='manual', effective rate calculated
Excel export /api/export/finance-excel contains 'PPh 22' and 'Tarif / Mode PPh' columns
Excel shows manual mode as 'Manual · x% efektif' with note
Finance summary totals include pph_rate_default, pph_effective_pct, pph_manual_days
UI: PPh setting form visible for admin only (data-testid: pph-setting-form, pph-default-rate-input, pph-default-save-button)
UI: PPh 22 column in finance table with badge ('Otomatis x%' / 'Manual · x% efektif')
UI: Edit PPh button (data-testid: edit-pph-{date}) opens modal
UI: PPh modal (data-testid: pph-modal) with mode switch (pph-mode-auto / pph-mode-manual)
UI: Auto mode shows rate input (pph-rate-input), manual mode shows amount input (pph-amount-input)
UI: Note input (pph-note-input) and preview (pph-preview) update correctly
UI: Save button (pph-save-button) and reset button (pph-reset-button) functional
Regression: All Excel exports working (complete, owners, daily, finance, prices)
